audit_refactor_findings.change: Introduced load_sync_session_checkpoint_resume_view as a read-only resume view that reports terminal and pending work.
audit_refactor_findings.finding: Rev0674 persisted completed fake-session evidence, but no public C++ API could consume the checkpoint rows after restart as typed recovery input.

audit_refactor_findings.change: Resume-view loading optionally validates expected folder, source-device, destination-device, and peer IDs against the persisted checkpoint row.
audit_refactor_findings.finding: Future recovery code must not trust caller memory about which folder/device/peer a checkpoint belongs to.

audit_refactor_findings.change: Refactored schema creation into ensure_sync_session_checkpoint_schema_or_throw and changed reload verification to bound session-id queries.
audit_refactor_findings.finding: SQLite checkpoint schema creation and reload verification were embedded in the writer, making future readers likely to duplicate SQL and reload checks.

audit_refactor_findings.change: Resume-view loading rejects database paths inside source, destination, or staging roots before opening SQLite.
audit_refactor_findings.finding: A restart reader must reject sync metadata databases inside synchronized or staging roots before SQLite open, not only during write-time checkpoint creation.
